verdict.rationale: The pack documents no Azure capability for bulk-exporting a customer's data in open formats to leave the platform. 'Export resources to HCL code' covers infrastructure configuration, not the user's stored data, so it is adjacent at best. The Cost Management APIs only explore cost and usage data, and the CLI and REST APIs are general building blocks, not a data-export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
